data.videoDescription: Someone flagged something odd about Lovable this week. So I looked into it. While the agent is working... it's sometimes thinking in Chinese. Not the output. The output is fine. The internal reasoning. Chinese characters. This is documented behaviour across multiple AI reasoning models. Chinese characters are more token-efficient. Some models just... do it. Because the training points that way. But the real story is the supply chain underneath. Which model is actually running? Which inference provider? Where do the reasoning traces go? Most security teams don't even know their people are using these tools. #CyberSecurity #AI #VibeCoding #InfoSec #techtok

data.videoDescription: Scammers quickly exploited the Venezuela earthquake by setting up fake donation websites, many asking for Bitcoin, and how this pattern repeats after disasters like Hurricane Harvey and COVID. We warn viewers to avoid crypto-only charity sites and suggest using legitimate charities, plus a idea for Google to add site reputation warnings. #cybersecurity #earthquake #scam #onlinesafety #techtok

data.videoDescription: Dutch intelligence says Russian hackers hijacked civilian internet connected cameras, including doorbells, to spy on NATO weapons routes into Ukraine. No brand named, no sophisticated exploit needed, just default passwords and outdated firmware. If you've got cheap connected kit at home, this is your reminder to check it. #CyberSecurity #smarthome #ukraine #NATO #IOT
